_comment: Curated OpenSim models from opensim-org/opensim-models (branch: master). Only .osim files are fetched: headless simulation (IK/ID/SO/Moco) does not need the .vtp mesh geometry, and the full repo is ~298 MB. Add your own entries freely; `filename` is what lands in src/models/.

arm26.description: 2-DOF, 6-muscle planar arm. The canonical minimal test model.

gait10dof18musc.description: 10-DOF, 18-muscle lower-body gait model. Best small model for a full IK->ID->SO pipeline.

gait2392.description: 23-DOF, 92-muscle gait model with Thelen2003 muscles. The most widely used OpenSim model.

gait2392_millard.description: As gait2392 but with Millard2012 equilibrium muscles.

rajagopal2016.description: 37-DOF, 80-muscle full-body model. Recommended for OpenSim Moco / predictive simulation.

wrist.description: Wrist model, useful for upper-limb and hand studies.
